objective: Drive engagement and click-throughs to the product page for the Rover Off-Roader.
persona_rationale: The Rover Off-Roader's robust build, dual motors, and off-road capabilities directly address the weekend explorer's desire for adventure and performance on varied terrain.
key_message: The Rover Off-Roader is built to tackle diverse Indian terrain, offering power and fun for weekend adventures.

proof_points.claim: Deep-treaded solid rubber tires glide over pavement, grass, or dirt.
proof_points.source: description: 'Whether it's the pavement, grass, or dirt, it delivers top-of-the-line performance always.'

proof_points.claim: Twin 350W hub motors climb slopes up to 10 degrees.
Charge in 150 minutes for more time riding.
